title.zh: Ethereum’s upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade clears rehearsal for a big jump in capacity
title.en: Ethereum’s upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade clears rehearsal for a big jump in capacity

current_state.zh: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade cleared a key rehearsal milestone, with Nethermind passing all 2,302 performance tests and the test network raising its block gas limit toward 200 million ahead of a proposed October 6 Sepolia deployment.
current_state.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade cleared a key rehearsal milestone, with Nethermind passing all 2,302 performance tests and the test network raising its block gas limit toward 200 million ahead of a proposed October 6 Sepolia deployment.
